acceptance.criterion: SourceDescriptor/v1 is the only new v4.5 classification input abstraction and represents LOCAL_FILE, LOCAL_DIRECTORY, LOCAL_GIT_REPOSITORY, GITHUB_REPOSITORY, CONTROLLED_FIXTURE and ORDERED_ATTACHMENT_SET without changing their evidence-only authority. acceptance.criterion: The bounded Source Resolver materializes a GitHub Source as an immutable static snapshot and records canonical repository identity, requested ref, full resolved commit, fetch-policy version, cache key, acquisition time, provenance and license discovery, redaction result and content digest; acquisition time is provenance and is excluded from the deterministic content snapshot digest. The same repository plus resolved commit and policy deterministically reuses the same snapshot; a moving ref that resolves differently creates a new Source and Evolution Context. Network, repository, ref or ambient-authentication failure, embedded credentials, submodules and Git LFS return typed blockers before Source reasoning.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Resolver schema and integration tests, pinned public-repository acquisition record, canonical URL/SSH normalization vectors, resolved-commit and snapshot golden digests, same-commit cache replay, moving-ref drift, failure matrix, embedded-credential rejection, private-auth readiness-only evidence and submodule/LFS blockers

acceptance.criterion: Classification handoff and every retained Harness stage bind the exact SourceDescriptor and resolved snapshot. A GitHub repository cannot be re-fetched implicitly after classification, and a local locator, ordered-set membership, repository identity, requested ref, resolved commit or snapshot-digest change invalidates the handoff and requires explicit re-analysis before Eligibility or Proposal work.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Cross-stage binding schema, stale and drift matrix for every Source type, no-refetch invocation counters, handoff and Proposal digest tests, independent-Host GitHub lifecycle evidence, and final designated-human RC01～RC05 completion declaration

acceptance.criterion: Through the generated Digital Expert in real WorkBuddy, an ordinary user can supply a local file or directory, local Git repository, GitHub repository locator or exact ordered attachment set and enter the same Engine-owned project-classification journey without atomic CLI commands, Source-type-specific lifecycle forks, personal-path leakage or Host-authored Source semantics.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Agent-neutral Core and generated-adapter parity, MCP discovery and schema tests, independent-Host Source-type matrix, repository-owned simulator conformance, primary-language scans, redacted provenance, no-atomic-CLI proof, and final designated-human RC01～RC05 completion declaration

acceptance.criterion: the RC01-RC05 compact portfolio machine matrix are reproducibly bound to one external read-only Source Portfolio by exact manifest digest, stable Source ids, declared case membership and ordered-set membership. The acceptance runner validates the binding before each case, never modifies Source material, never substitutes an unbound Source, and reports only safe Source identity and immutable snapshot evidence.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Portfolio schema and digest, existence/type preflight, case-binding validator, ordered-set digest and drift negatives, read-only filesystem/process trace, redacted evidence scan and the RC01-RC05 compact portfolio machine matrix source-to-outcome matrix

acceptance.criterion: The cumulative v4.4.0 GitHub repository Source outcome remains available on the fresh v4.5.0 baseline and now completes classification through explicit handoff and the retained Harness producer lifecycle. A pinned public repository reaches validated test-Catalog publication and safe close; same-commit replay, moving-ref drift, unavailable network/repository/ref, missing private authentication, embedded credentials, suspected secrets, Source prompt injection, build/workflow files, submodules and Git LFS each preserve deterministic, redacted, static-only, fail-closed behavior.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Pinned public GitHub independent-Host lifecycle, same-commit and moving-ref records, complete typed-blocker matrix, credential and secret scans, static-only command/network trace, publication validation and close receipts, plus final designated-human RC01～RC05 completion declaration

acceptance.criterion: GitHubDiscoveryPlan/v1 deterministically executes one exact official GitHub repository-search query only after the exact release build, CandidateAcceptanceBinding/v1, complete compact-portfolio non-WorkBuddy base matrix and all five release-build-bound WorkBuddy runbooks are frozen. Every WorkBuddy human-operation leg remains PENDING. acceptance.requiredEvidence: GitHubDiscoveryPlan executor tests and one fresh append-only discovery manifest bound to the exact Target and CandidateAcceptanceBinding/v1, including query, API version, pages, timestamp, rate-limit provenance, response digest, deterministic rejection reasons, freeze time and proof that release-build output was unavailable during selection

acceptance.criterion: Before release-build execution, deterministic metadata and acquisition eligibility select exactly one responsibility-focused public repository. It is independently pre-adjudicated as TAXONOMY_MATCHED against the controlled classification scheme, pinned to a full commit and immutable static snapshot, and recorded in one selection manifest. A candidate-blind expected-result record is frozen from static evidence, advisory LLM provenance and explicit human confirmation. Selection or expected result cannot change after release-build output is visible.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Complete ranked candidate and rejection ledger for one query, responsibility-focus eligibility check, full-commit and snapshot binding, selection-manifest digest, pre-execution expected-result record, human confirmation receipt, release-build-output isolation trace and post-freeze mutation negatives

acceptance.criterion: The one frozen GitHub Source executes in the independent non-WorkBuddy Host from its pinned local snapshot with zero implicit refetch and zero Source commands, and must reach the exact independently pre-adjudicated TAXONOMY_MATCHED terminal. WorkBuddy RC05 independently covers one representative pinned repository as the complete human classification-to-Harness journey; other classification and Harness branches remain mandatory in the fixed Source Portfolio and deterministic matrices.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: One-source frozen machine report with snapshot binding, independent expected result, matching classification terminal, zero-network-after-freeze and no-execution trace, no-replacement proof and one-of-one completeness check; separate RC05 human-runbook completion declaration only for the representative WorkBuddy leg

acceptance.criterion: After the fixed user-provided Source Portfolio machine matrix passes and all five release-build-bound WorkBuddy runbooks are frozen, release acceptance adds one fresh GitHub Source rather than relying only on known local material. acceptance.requiredEvidence: Fixed Source Portfolio matrix, five-runbook freeze manifest, one fresh GitHub discovery report, complete one-source machine execution evidence, before/after WorkBuddy range-declaration status tests and proof that no extra human journey was created

acceptance.criterion: The one-Source live GitHub machine wave proves bounded GitHub acquisition, immutable pinned replay and one candidate-blind TAXONOMY_MATCHED classification with equivalent Engine-owned semantics in the independent conformant Host. WorkBuddy RC05 uses one representative responsibility-focused repository and does not fabricate exact business-label truth for broad or mixed repositories.

acceptance.requiredEvidence: One-of-one accounting ledger, forced-failure and replacement negative tests, interrupted/resumed acquisition proof, zero-network-after-freeze proof, append-only discovery-wave history, prior failed-wave preservation and release-gate blocker evidence
